        <footnote id="F1">These are restricted stock units (&quot;RSUs&quot;) issued under the Ingredion Incorporated Stock Incentive Plan. The RSUs may be settled only in shares of common stock (one share per RSU) and will vest in three equal annual installments, with one-third vesting on October 15, 2027, one-third vesting on October 15, 2028, and one-third vesting on October 15, 2029.
